content_sections.heading: About Amrita Administrative Officer Recruitment
content_sections.text: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham is a multi-campus, multi-disciplinary research university. The Amaravati Campus in Andhra Pradesh is currently recruiting a qualified non-teaching professional to manage administrative responsibilities, student documentation, fee tracking, transport coordination, and hostel arrangements.

content_sections.heading: Amrita Administrative Officer Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will be responsible for the following duties and responsibilities: Candidate should have experience in document verification of the students. He should be able to do the Undertakings HOD's/Chairperson. He should be responsible to check fees has paid intime. He should be responsible for hostel fee payments and coordinate with wardens in allotment of hostel rooms. He should be responsible for fee refunds if the students withdraw his/her admission. He should be responsible for preparation of Transfer Certificates and Campus Transfers. He is responsible for bus allotments and route allocations in coordination with transport department.

content_sections.heading: Essential Skills
content_sections.text: Candidate should be good at communication (verbal and written) and interpersonal skills. He should have any degree or equivalent.
